-1.description: Use protocol version 1 only (no longer supported)

-B.description: Bind to the address of this network interface

-C.description: Compress all data on the connection

-D.description: Open a dynamic SOCKS proxy on this local port

-E.description: Append debug logs to this file instead of stderr

-F.description: Read this configuration file instead of ~/.ssh/config

-G.description: Print the effective configuration and exit

-I.description: Load this PKCS#11 shared library for key access

-J.description: Connect through this jump host first

-K.description: Enable GSSAPI authentication and credential forwarding

-L.description: Forward a local port to a remote address

-M.description: Put the client into master mode for connection sharing

-N.description: Do not run a remote command; only forward ports

-O.description: Send a control command to a master process: check, forward, cancel, exit or stop

-P.description: Select ssh_config sections with this tag

-Q.description: Query supported algorithms: cipher, mac, kex, key, sig and more

-R.description: Forward a remote port to a local address

-S.description: Use this control socket for connection sharing

-W.description: Forward standard input and output to this host:port

-a.description: Disable forwarding of the authentication agent

-b.description: Use this local address as the connection source

-c.description: Use this cipher specification for the session

-e.description: Use this escape character, or none

-f.description: Go to the background after authentication

-g.description: Allow remote hosts to connect to locally forwarded ports

-i.description: Read the private key from this identity file

-m.description: Use this MAC specification for the session

-o.description: Set a configuration option, such as Port=2222

-p.description: Connect to this port on the remote host

-q.description: Quiet mode; suppress warnings and diagnostics

-s.description: Request a subsystem such as sftp on the remote host

-v.description: Verbose mode; repeat for more detail

-y.description: Send log output to syslog instead of stderr
